# ApexAML

> Compliance Intelligence platform for Nigerian fintechs, banks and IMTOs. CBN-aligned AML controls — AI STR co-pilot, BVN/NIN KYC, transaction monitoring with Nigerian typologies, and NFIU goAML reporting.

ApexAML is built specifically to satisfy the 10 capability areas mandated by CBN Circular BSD/DIR/PUB/LAB/019/002 (initial submission deadline 10 June 2026). Data is hosted in the eu-west-1 (Ireland) region, encrypted in transit and at rest; data residency options are available on request.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview, pricing, FAQ and lead capture for Nigerian financial institutions.
- [CBN Roadmap Generator](/roadmap): Free tool that generates a CBN-compliant AML implementation roadmap, pre-formatted for Circular BSD/DIR/PUB/LAB/019/002.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How ApexAML collects, processes and stores personal data under the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023.

## Optional

- [Sign in](/login): Restricted login for compliance officers at customer institutions.
